supported_scope: Multi-file architectural changes, complex refactoring, and unfamiliar codebase investigations with planning and review
required_setup: Use plan mode (--mode=plan) to analyze and outline multi-file changes before writing code; default mode pauses for interactive diff review before modifying or creating files; configure rules and workspace environment for directory standards and styling paradigms
constraints: Agent prompts for approval before writing code files unless configured otherwise
Tool permission rules govern shell commands across all execution modes
Artifact review policy controls when prompts for reviewing generated artifacts occur

evidence.section: Choose an execution mode > Analyze tasks before editing with plan mode
evidence.quote: Use plan mode when taking on complex refactoring, multi-file architectural changes, or unfamiliar codebase investigations.
evidence.claim: Plan mode supports multi-file architectural changes and complex refactoring

evidence.section: Choose an execution mode > Available modes
evidence.quote: plan Prepends the /plan instruction prefix to analyze and outline steps before writing code. Exploring unfamiliar architecture or designing complex multi-step features.
evidence.claim: Plan mode analyzes and outlines steps before writing code for multi-file changes

evidence.section: Choose an execution mode > Available modes
evidence.quote: default Pauses for interactive diff review before modifying or creating files. Standard development, reviewing sensitive code changes, and careful refactoring.
evidence.claim: Default mode supports interactive review of file modifications and creations

evidence.section: CLI best practices > Configure your workspace environment > Write a codebase rule file
evidence.quote: Create a GEMINI.md or AGENTS.md file at your workspace root to outline specific directory standards, styling paradigms, test command parameters, and deprecation warnings. The agent automatically parses these rules on startup and consults them before suggesting changes.
evidence.claim: Workspace environment configuration supports consistent multi-file changes
